exposure.needed: whether the environment's ACME HTTP-01 challenges are solved against IPv6 endpoints (the IP family of the HTTP-01 solver endpoints)

consequence.statement: For environments whose ACME HTTP-01 challenges are solved against IPv6 endpoints, the upgrade changes the solver's behavior: the IPv6 handling that previously did not work correctly is fixed, so HTTP-01 solving against IPv6 endpoints now behaves differently (it works) with no configuration change.
consequence.remediation: No action required; re-verify ACME HTTP-01 challenges against IPv6 endpoints after upgrading and retire any workarounds kept for this bug.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 fixes the ACME HTTP-01 solver for IPv6 endpoints, where it previously did not work correctly.
